SELECT status, fulfilment_type, login_state, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 20:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-02 04:00:00'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
 SELECT *, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) AS local_date
 FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT local_date, status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d
FROM o WHERE local_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-30' AND DATE '2025-12-02' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_web_order_load) stg, (SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM stg_web_order_load) stgd FROM fact_web_order

WITH o AS (
 SELECT *, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) AS local_date
 FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 22:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 22:00:00'),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) nl, count(DISTINCT line_no) dl, sum(gross_amount) g, min(channel_code) cc, min(sale_date) sd, max(sale_date) sd2 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, count(*) orders, count(l.receipt_id) with_lines, sum(CASE WHEN l.nl<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN l.nl<>l.dl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dup_lines, sum(CASE WHEN l.sd<>o.local_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) saledate_diff, sum(CASE WHEN l.sd<>CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) saledate_utc_diff
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id GROUP BY 1
